tutorials.text:
# Slay the Spire II Setup

This guide takes you from installing the mod to connecting to a game. If someone
else is generating and hosting, you only need steps 1, 2 and 4.

We recommend the game's **beta branch**, where Terairk mainly develops and tests
the mod. Beta updates can temporarily break the mod until it is updated.

To switch, right-click Slay the Spire 2 in your Steam library, select
**Properties** > **Game Versions & Betas**, and select **public-beta** instead of
**Default Public Version**. Steam then downloads the beta version. To switch back,
select **Default Public Version** again.

Main-branch support is on thin ice. The mod still runs there, but it is largely
untested and new features are not supported on it: The Fool, Dread Mode and Blitz
Merchants need the beta branch. Multiplayer on the main branch will stop being
supported in a future release, because beta 0.113.0 changed the game's multiplayer
code substantially.

## 1. Install the mod

1. Subscribe to [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295)
   (version 0.6.16 or newer) and [Slay the Spire II Archipelago](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296)
   on Steam Workshop. The [Slay the Spire 2 Archipelago Minimal Install](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3839147144)
   collection has both, plus Mod Launch Manager (below): select **Subscribe to all**
   to get all three at once.
2. Wait for Steam to finish downloading the mods, then start the game.

Prefer not to use Workshop? See [Manual installation](#manual-installation).

We also recommend [Mod Launch Manager](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3788556097) by Snowline on Steam Workshop.
With it, you can enable all your mods in Steam's Workshop tab, see when mods update,
and keep mod profiles to switch between different sets of mods.

## 2. Make your YAML

A YAML is the file that holds your settings for the game. The easiest way to make
one is the YAML Builder at <https://sts2ap.terairk.dev/#/builder>. It walks through
every option and downloads a finished YAML, and it can import a YAML you already have
to edit it. The mod's **Mod Website & YAML Builder** main-menu button opens the same
builder.

**Modded characters (optional):** see [Predefined modded characters](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/predefined_characters_en.md)
for those with ready-made names and [Finding a modded character ID](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/modded_characters_en.md)
for any other.

Other ways to make a YAML:

- The builder on the main site, <https://sts2ap.net/#/builder>, works too, but it
  gets new options later.
- Edit `Spire2-template.yaml` from the mod release by hand, or use the Archipelago
  Launcher's **Options Creator**. Set `name` to the slot name you want.

YAMLs from either builder still work regardless of if they miss options or have extra options 
compared to options-creator and template: extra options are ignored and missing options
use their defaults.

## 3. Generate and host the game

If someone else is doing this, send them your YAML (and the link to the APworld releases) and 
skip to step 4.

1. Install [Archipelago Launcher](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
   v0.6.7 or newer.
2. Download the `.apworld` file from the same mod release.
3. Open the Launcher, select **Install APWorld**, and choose that file. On Windows,
   double-clicking the file also works if the Launcher installed its file association.
4. Use **Browse Files** in the Launcher, open `Players`, and put the players' YAML
   files there.
5. Select **Generate**. The resulting ZIP is written to `output` in the Archipelago
   folder.

To play online, upload the ZIP at [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/) and create
a room, or use your preferred Archipelago server. Keep the room's server address,
port and any password. You can also host locally to playtest before a sync.

## 4. Connect and play

1. Start Slay the Spire II with the Archipelago mod and RitsuLib enabled.
2. Select **Connect to Archipelago** on the main menu.
3. Enter the server address and port, your YAML's slot name and any password.
4. Connect, then follow the mod's character and run selection.

You don't need the Launcher to play, but we recommend it for two optional tools.
**Universal Tracker** shows what's in logic; search up the `universal-tracker`
channel on the main Archipelago Discord. The **Text Client** lets you see and send hints.

The [hinting guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/hinting_en.md)
explains what each item and location means, how to earn each check, and how to hint.

## Multiplayer

The mod supports the game's co-op. See the [multiplayer setup guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/multiplayer_setup_en.md)
for what everyone needs, hosting and joining.

## Troubleshooting

See the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/troubleshooting_en.md) for things to check and
fixes for common problems.

## Manual installation

Install only one copy of the Archipelago mod. If you were using the Workshop item,
unsubscribe from it first, and keep RitsuLib installed separately.

1. Download `Archipelago.zip` from the release you want to play.
2. In Steam, open Slay the Spire 2's **Browse Local Files** action.
3. Create `mods/Archipelago` inside that game directory and extract the ZIP's
   contents into it.
4. Confirm that `Archipelago.dll`, `Archipelago.json`, the PCK and the `lib/` and
   `data/` directories are directly inside `mods/Archipelago`, without an extra
   nested `Archipelago` folder.
5. Start the game.

readme.text: # Slay the Spire 2 Archipelago Archipelago Client & APWorld for STS2 # Download the Latest Playable Release [Here](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) > [!IMPORTANT] > We recommend the **beta branch**, where Terairk mainly develops and tests the mod. > The main branch remains supported, but receives little, if any, gameplay testing; > compatibility is assessed primarily through compile-time checks and player bug reports. > Beta branch updates can temporarily break compatibility until the mod is updated. > > The client contains exact builds for the main branch **v0.111.1** and beta branch > **v0.113.1** game versions. ## 1.0 Development onwards This mod is currently in 2.0 stage and is practically feature-parity with the AP from the StS1. While there are some edge case bugs, most people have successfully played an Archipelago with this world and had no issues. > [!WARNING] > The mod only supports English at the moment, but as we understand localization better, we can work with the community to support more languages # [Setup Guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/setup_en.md) The [setup guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/setup_en.md) covers installing the mod, making your YAML, generating and hosting a game, connecting, and playing in multiplayer. ## Installing the Mod There are two ways to install the mod, detailed below. ### Steam Workshop Subscribe to the mod on the [steam workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296). Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. ### Manual installation 1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Download `Archipelago.zip` from the [Releases](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) section of the repo 3. Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") 4. If a folder called `mods` does not exist, create it 5. Put `Archipelago.zip` in `mods`, then extract it into the archive program's default `Archipelago` directory - If you've done this step correctly, `mods/Archipelago/` contains the loader DLL, common dependencies, the PCK, and `lib/0.111.1/` and `lib/0.113.1/`. Keep that directory structure intact. - The bundled `spire2.apworld` matches this mod version. Hosts can install it through the Archipelago Launcher's **Install APWorld**; see Archipelago's guide to [playing with custom worlds](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en#playing-with-custom-worlds). 6. Start the game # Features ## What's Included - Card/Relic Rewards shuffled in the multiworld - Goldsanity - Campfiresanity (Progressive Rest/Smith) - Potionsanity - Saving to the AP Server, and Saving when Connection is Lost - Death Link - Shopsanity (currently playable but may lack some polish) - Interesting Filler Items - Progressive Ancients - Progressive Starter Card and Relic (ie None -> Bash -> Break) - Multiplayer Support - Traps (more will be added) - Modded Character Support > [!CAUTION] > Mods such as modded character are supported but may or may not work. I do know that 'Downfall Classic' and 'IntoTheSpireVerse' and also 'Watcher by Lamali' all work well as of the 2.0.0 release. # Special Thanks - [Archipelago.MultiClient.Net](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago.MultiClient.Net) - Platano Bailando for creating the StS 1 Archipelago that inspires this one! - [lamali292](https://github.com/lamali292) for their initial guide on creating mods for Slay the Spire 2! - [alwaysintreble](https://github.com/alwaysintreble/ArchipelagoBepInExPluginTemplate/tree/master) for their example Archipelago C# Plugin Template - [Spire Codex](https://spire-codex.com) for providing an awesome public API that helps us stay up-to-date with Slay the Spire 2 data for our item pools - The Eager and Exposing enchantment icons are [Power lightning](https://game-icons.net/1x1/lorc/power-lightning.html) and [Broken shield](https://game-icons.net/1x1/lorc/broken-shield.html) by Lorc from [game-icons.net](https://game-icons.net), under [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), recoloured - All of the wonderful contributors to the project! # Roadmap You can view the current roadmap in detail [here](https://github.com/users/dlueben1/projects/1)

notes.text:
> [!WARNING]
> Steam workshop's update process is down currently as of 25/11/2026 due to a malware wave. So this includes many many mods including RitsuLib and us, as such there is no current workshop release for our dependencies and our mod. So you must download RitsuLib and this mod manually. https://github.com/BAKAOLC/STS2-RitsuLib/releases. Download the variant pack version and install it manually like you would this mod.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Play on the game's beta branch.** Main-branch support is on thin ice but supported none the less: the mod still runs there, but it's largely untested and new game features might not be supported on it.

## Setup

For installation, YAML configuration, generation and connection instructions, see
[the Slay the Spire II setup guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/setup_en.md).

Archipelago **Launcher v0.6.7+** is required for generation. Install **STS2-RitsuLib 0.6.16+** separately. https://github.com/BAKAOLC/STS2-RitsuLib/releases. Download the variant pack version and install it manually like you would this mod.

The newest YAML Builder is at [sts2ap.terairk.dev](https://sts2ap.terairk.dev/#/builder), and the mod's **Mod Website & YAML Builder** button opens it. [sts2ap.net](https://sts2ap.net/#/builder) gets the new options later.

# Version Information

- **Archipelago Mod:** 2.2.4
- **APWorld:** 1.4.2
- **Slay the Spire II main branch:** v0.111.1
- **Slay the Spire II beta branch:** v0.114.0

# Changelist

1) Character relics can now spawn in treasure chests (bypassing base game behaviour for fun's sake).
2) Support for v0.114.0 on the beta branch.
3) Re-added the Back button to the character select screen.
4) The Archipelago button on the top bar now shows its keybind in keyboard-only mode, like the Deck and Map buttons.

### Version compatibility

The APWorld is still 1.4.2, so seeds generated for 2.2.3 work with this mod. This mod needs STS2-RitsuLib 0.6.16 or newer.

Everyone in a multiplayer lobby should use the same mod version and game branch.

Tested in singleplayer on the beta branch.

## Known Issues/Limitations

- **Main branch:** largely untested and gets no new features. Main-branch multiplayer might not be supported in a future release.
- In multiplayer, AP menu rewards can only be claimed outside combat; Death Fragments are disabled. **Anytime** Ancient rewards are recommended.
